ABOUT THE NOIDA CLINIC

A sanctuary for skin, Dermatology & Aesthetics in Noida.

Our flagship Noida clinic is a calm, elegant sanctuary purpose-built for advanced skin, hair and laser treatments. From acne and pigmentation to anti-ageing, hair restoration and aesthetic surgery, every treatment plan is curated to your unique skin and lifestyle. With state-of-the-art USFDA-approved equipment and a discreet, luxurious ambience, Reviva Noida is the trusted choice of thousands of patients across Delhi NCR.

Led by Dr. Aarushi Tyagi, board-certified dermatologist (MBBS, MD, DNB Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy), our Noida clinic offers personalised treatments for every hair, skin, and nail concern — backed by the latest USFDA-approved technology.
